test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Novel
solution:
The correct answer is **Traditional.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word **'Novel' -**
 
• **Novel - **new and original, not like anything seen before.
 
 
• Example - A novel idea/suggestion
 
 
 
• The word** 'Traditional'** means ' following or belonging to the ways of behaving or beliefs that have been established for a long time'
 
 
• Example - This beer has been brewed using traditional methods​​
 
 
 
• From the above points, it is clear that **Option 3** is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Formal **means **did according to protocol or etiquette; appropriate for or defining an official or significant occasion.**
 
• **Ancient **means **being extinct and being from a very long time ago.**
 
• **Customary **means** according to the traditions or norms of a specific community, location, or set of circumstances.**
